title: Run Commands from the Web
subtitle: Get a code once in-game, then run commands here for 7 days
step1Prefix: In the game chat box, type
step2: A private message shows a 6-digit code and your player ID (visible only to you)
step3: Enter both below. Once verified, you stay signed in for 7 days
scamWarning: Only enter this code on this page, which you opened yourself. Anyone asking you for it is scamming you.
verifyFailed: Invalid or expired code. Type /webcode in game to get a new one.
codeRules: The code is valid for 5 minutes and single-use. Requests have a 30-second cooldown, and the code is voided after 5 failed attempts. You must be online in game to run commands.
offlineHint: You are not in the game right now. Commands need a live game session — please log in to the game first.
resultSent: Sent — check the result in game
resultRejected: Command not recognised, check the spelling or arguments
resultOffline: You are not online. Log in to the game before running commands.
resultBadRequest: Command was empty or too long
resultRateLimited: Too many requests, please slow down
advancedHint: All game commands are supported, up to 2048 characters. Command output is delivered to your game client only — it is never shown on this page.
permissionNote: This channel does exactly what typing the command in the game chat box does — it grants no extra privileges. Admin commands are still gated by your account's own admin flag, so a regular player running one here is rejected the same way it would be in game.
